_comment: Expected per-level hashes and fingerprints of docs/features/hash-levels.md (5a-1) over this fixture: TE-1 (pairs), TE-2 (the committed rustfmt variants), TE-3 (broken units), TE-6 (v2 equivalence). No digest is stored here: every expectation is a relation (`equal` or `differs` between two units), a count, a target list or an error category, each of them derivable from the spec by hand. The digests themselves are pinned by RD-3 `level_streams_are_pinned` and, independently of the implementation, by the recipe oracles of crates/specengine-code/tests/hash_levels_props.rs. A pair takes unit `a` of `file`, applies `edit` (its `from` must occur exactly once) and takes unit `b` (default: `a`) of the edited text; without `edit`, `a` and `b` are two units of the same text. A locator names an item by `kind` and `label` (`ItemRecord::label`), plus `owner` for a method and `mod_path` inside an inline `mod` (absent: none); `{"module": true}` is the file module. Every pair also holds on the in-memory CRLF copy of both sides. `v2: n5` names the only pairs whose whole-item v2 hash may change while `sig` and `body` do not; `cr_exceptions` names the only items whose v2 hash changes under CRLF. `files` lists every unit of every `.rs` file outside `variants/` in analysis order. Categories `null` are v2's (`hash_item`, `error_categories`), not pinned by hand.

variants._comment: Committed rustfmt outputs of every file under src/ (TE-2): each is a fixed point of `rustfmt --edition 2024 --check` with the named config (fmt-60: run from a directory holding a rustfmt.toml with that line), and holds the same tokens as its src/ file but for rustfmt's own rewrites (sorted `use`, `mod` and `extern crate` runs, closure and match-arm braces, commas, layout). Regenerate after editing a src/ file: `rustfmt --edition 2024 --emit stdout < src/x.rs > variants/fmt-default/src/x.rs`, the same with `--config max_width=60` into variants/fmt-60/. nofmt/ (rustc refuses its forms) and broken/ (parse errors) have no variant.

ron._comment: docs/features/hash-levels-ron.md (5a-1b) TE-1 over every .ron file of ron/, read by crates/specengine-eval/tests/hash_levels_ron_fixture.rs. A RON value hash is one digest per comment whose anchor is a path (`ron::value_hashes`, keyed by the comment's byte range). No digest is stored here. `files` lists, per file, either the comments that get an entry, in source order, each with its path and its value's canonical rendering (the value's tokens after the recipe's drops, one space apart, LF line ends: `/* v */ <canonical>` must hash alike), and the comments that get none, with their anchor; or the refusal: `detail` is the first of `categories` (RonAnalysis::error_categories), and `path_comments` lists the comments with a path anchor, which the refusal covers. `pairs` relate the value of comment `a` in `file` to that of comment `b` (default `a`) in the text after `edit` (its `from` occurs exactly once; without `edit`, `a` and `b` are two comments of one text); each names its mutation and holds on LF and on the in-memory CRLF copy of both sides. A comment is named by its whole text, a line comment without its line end. Every form of `forms` has an equal and a differs pair; `root` is an extra form. (L1) and the like name the test-engineer's readings, recorded at shipping in the spec's Implementation section.
